hypotheses.B0_broad_endpoint_coverage: At least six families retain four or more disjoint equal-length pairs with positive native semantic effects.
hypotheses.B1_destination_variables_emerge: At least five families reach destination-state projection share 0.50 at some layer on held-out pairs.
hypotheses.B2_construction_branches_are_not_univers: At frozen discovery-selected crossing sites, at least two of carried state, attention, and MLP are the largest held-out branch across the family suite.
hypotheses.B3_attention_pulses_often_have_compact_h: Frozen top-three head programs reach held-out energy fidelity 0.80 for at least four families with nontrivial attention target energy.
hypotheses.B4_no_single_universal_head: At least three distinct heads occupy the frozen top rank across families.
hypotheses.B5_negation_is_not_assumed_to_be_plain_s: Plain and negated sentiment are compared prospectively by crossing layer, branch profile, and head-program overlap; equality is not built into discovery.
